articles.title: Klay Thompson net worth 2026: Salary and career earnings as NBA star starts new Miami Heat chapter
articles.summary: Klay Thompson has built a remarkable career in the NBA.
articles.body: Klay Thompson has built a remarkable career in the NBA. The five-time All-Star became one of the league’s greatest shooters during his 13 seasons with the Golden State Warriors. Alongside Stephen Curry, he formed the famous “Splash Brothers” duo. He helped Golden State win four NBA championships.Thompson left the Warriors in 2024 and spent two seasons with the Dallas Mavericks. After negotiating a buyout in August 2026, he agreed to join the Miami Heat on a two-year contract worth nearly $13 million. His career has also included major endorsement deals, investments and memorable shooting records.Klay Thompson’s net worth 2026Klay Thompson’s net worth is estimated at around $180 million (per celebrity net worth). His NBA contracts have been the biggest source of his wealth. Through the end of the 2025-26 season, he had earned around $299 million in NBA salary.Thompson entered the NBA in 2011 after the Warriors selected him with the 11th overall pick. His rookie contract was worth roughly $9.7 million over four years. He later signed a four-year extension worth nearly $69 million in 2014.In 2019, Golden State gave Thompson a five-year maximum contract worth around $189.9 million. The deal came shortly after he suffered an ACL injury in the NBA Finals. He later suffered an Achilles injury and missed more than two full seasons.Thompson returned in January 2022. He helped the Warriors win the NBA championship that season. It was his fourth title with the franchise.After leaving Golden State, Thompson joined the Dallas Mavericks in 2024 on a three-year, $50 million contract. He earned $15.87 million in his first season and $16.67 million in his second.His role decreased during the 2025-26 season. Thompson averaged 11.7 points, 2.1 rebounds and 1.4 assists in 69 games. He continued to shoot well from three-point range, finishing the season at 38.3%.In August 2026, Thompson and Dallas agreed to a buyout. He then reached an agreement with the Miami Heat on a two-year deal worth nearly $13 million.A major part of Thompson’s wealth also comes from endorsements. His biggest partnership is with Chinese sportswear company Anta. He signed with the brand after leaving Nike and developed the popular “KT” signature sneaker line.In February 2026, Anta announced a lifetime partnership with Thompson. The deal marked the first lifetime basketball endorsement agreement in Anta’s history.Thompson has also worked with brands including BodyArmor, Tissot, Fanatics, Panini, Cash App, Mercedes-Benz and Subway.Away from basketball, Thompson has invested in businesses and owned several luxury properties. He also has a strong connection with California and previously owned a waterfront home in Belvedere.Thompson’s career has been shaped by championships, injuries and an elite shooting ability. articles.title: 76ers' Ariel Hukporti Suffers Season-Ending Injury, Updated Depth Chart and Salary Cap Space
articles.summary: The Philadelphia 76ers announced that center Ariel Hukporti suffered a season-ending torn right Achilles tendon during his team's preseason opener on Monday evening against the New York Knicks.
articles.body:
The Philadelphia 76ers announced that center Ariel Hukporti suffered a season-ending torn right Achilles tendon during his team's preseason opener on Monday evening against the New York Knicks.

Hukporti, who played his first two seasons with the New York Knicks, signed a one-year, $3.4 million deal with the 76ers in July. The 24-year-old played 54 games last year (five starts) for the NBA champions.

Here's a look at the 76ers' current depth chart with Hukporti out for the year.

SF: Jaylen Brown, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Justin Edwards

PF: LeBron James, Dean Wade, Dominick Barlow

C: Joel Embiid, Adem Bona, Jabari Walker

The 76ers are over the cap by $53.9 million, per Spotrac . They have $1.8 million in space below the first apron and $14.5 million below the second apron.

ESPN's Bobby Marks provided more insight on the 76ers' cap outlook following the news on Hukporti.

The 76ers are currently thin at center with backup Adem Bona out due to a sprain in his left foot suffered while playing for Turkey during World Cup qualifiers this summer, per Tony Jones of The Athletic.

Bona did not play Monday. ESPN's Dave McMenamin reported on Oct. 1 that Bona would be reevaluated in the next few days.

Jones gave insight Monday into what the 76ers might do at center without Hukporti, noting Jabari Walker and Dominick Barlow could be bigger factors behind Embiid.

The 6'7", 237-pound Walker played 64 games (six starts) for the 76ers last year, averaging 4.3 points and 3.0 rebounds per game in 11.9 minutes per game.

The 6'9", 215-pound Barlow played 71 games and made 59 starts for last year's 76ers team. He averaged 7.7 points and 4.8 rebounds per game.

The 76ers begin their season on Tuesday, Oct. 20 at the Knicks.
